cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your brother's place at dinner is approved. Please give him my pie; I'm delighted he can join us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I find you something else? You haven't eaten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your concern is appreciated. Peas are approved; my breakfast was quite substantial, several hours ago.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order a pizza for you. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pizza is approved, thank you. I'll keep everyone company while they eat; then you may all enjoy watching me begin when you've finished.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 graciously approves minimal food and A5 approves delayed pizza while making the accepted inconvenience publicly visible.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 hunger concern causes A3 peas and old-breakfast reassurance; B4 forty-minute remedy causes A5 reversed dinner-watching roles.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 actively try to feed A, keeping the scene considerate while A makes sacrifice conspicuous.

heightening.evidence: B4 helpful solution extends the cost into delayed eating, which A5 accepts with pointedly gracious company.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra diner and surrendered pie, B2 hunger and B4 pizza wait establish the ordinary sacrifice.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 others watching A begin is earned by the actual delay rather than an arbitrary new hardship.
